# Rad UI

> Rad UI is a modern, headless React component library focused on accessibility, TypeScript, and unstyled primitives for building custom design systems.

## Core
- [Introduction](https://www.rad-ui.com/docs/first-steps/introduction)
- [Installation](https://www.rad-ui.com/docs/first-steps/installation)
- [Usage](https://www.rad-ui.com/docs/first-steps/usage)
- [Changelog](https://www.rad-ui.com/docs/first-steps/changelog)

## Rad UI FX
> Accessible animated components (text effects, backgrounds), installed as source through a shadcn-compatible registry. Each registry item lists its accessibility rules in `meta.accessibility`.
- [FX Introduction](https://www.rad-ui.com/fx)
- [FX Installation](https://www.rad-ui.com/fx/installation)
